description: Opaque ivory ankle-length tunic-robe with fine gold geometric embroidery along the crossed neckline and vertical front, worn over loose ivory trousers. A dark burgundy-brown open outer robe reaches nearly to the ankles, with broad gold geometric woven borders along the opening, sleeve ends and hem. A wide gold-brown patterned waist sash is wrapped several times and has long fringed ends hanging down the front. Brown closed leather shoes have gold stitched geometric ornament. The robes have wide natural sleeves and show an average adult male frame. No turban, headgear, armor or weapon is present.
